newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices steady, arrivals fall.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices steady, arrivals fall.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Monday held steady at a reduced level of 1,120/1,122 rupees per quintal amid limited activity, traders said.
"Reports of easing pressure on arrivals at producing centres has cut selling at the lowest level," one trader said.
Groundnut oil fell by 2/3 rupees at 349/350 rupees per 10 grammes on the back of falling prices of imported oils.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil fell by five rupees to 550 rupees per 15 kg.
In Bombay, imported palm oil slid by two rupees to 264/265 rupees per 10 kg as world market losses triggered fresh unloading by local importers.
